panels.description: Shows the avg speeds received by test site

targets.query:
import "join"

downloadBase = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "download")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bandwidth")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["server_id", "server_name", "server_location"])

downloadAvg = downloadBase
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["server_id", "server_name", "server_location", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "download_avg"})
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])

downloadCount = downloadBase
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["server_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "test_count"})
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])

uploadAvg = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "upload")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bandwidth")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["server_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "upload_avg"})
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])

pingAvg = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["server_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "ping"})
  |> group(columns: ["server_id"])

withCount = join.left(
  left: downloadAvg,
  right: downloadCount,
  on: (l, r) => l.server_id == r.server_id,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    server_id: l.server_id,
    server_name: l.server_name,
    server_location: l.server_location,
    download_avg: l.download_avg,
    test_count: if exists r.test_count then r.test_count else 0.0,
  }),
)

withUpload = join.left(
  left: withCount,
  right: uploadAvg,
  on: (l, r) => l.server_id == r.server_id,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    server_id: l.server_id,
    server_name: l.server_name,
    server_location: l.server_location,
    download_avg: l.download_avg,
    test_count: l.test_count,
    upload_avg: if exists r.upload_avg then r.upload_avg else 0.0,
  }),
)

join.left(
  left: withUpload,
  right: pingAvg,
  on: (l, r) => l.server_id == r.server_id,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    server_id: l.server_id,
    Server: l.server_name,
    Location: l.server_location,
    Ping: if exists r.ping then r.ping else 0.0,
    "Download Avg": l.download_avg,
    "Upload Avg": l.upload_avg,
    "Test Count": l.test_count,
  }),
)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Ping", "Server"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "download")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bandwidth")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "speedtest_url"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Down Mbps"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "upload")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bandwidth")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "speedtest_url"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Up Mbps"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency" or r._field == "jitter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "speedtest_url"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {latency: "Latency ms", jitter: "Jitter ms"})
